assumptions: All 18 cases intentionally remain test.skip per installed ATDD conventions and root direction; none is accepted coverage.
Success is target-only {targetId}; audit metadata permits only targetId and validates it when present. No empty metadata shape is imposed.
Stable user-safe COMMAND_CONFLICT and SERVER_ERROR are approved; validation/foreign-parent cases accept only documented validation/access outcomes.
No HTTP endpoint, browser route, Playwright utilities or Pact package is added. Vitest and internal SQL commands are the relevant execution layer.
Conflict fixtures test schema/workflow visibility and references only. No detector output or engine behavior is fabricated.
Production faults require an implementation-local test seam; the current helper only controls a seed-installed real database fault and calls actual production commands.
Membership race uses a real row lock and bounded inspection of pg_blocking_pids before deactivation, not an arbitrary timing delay.
